newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA SIGN ARGENTINE ANGEL MORALES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SAMPDORIA SIGN ARGENTINE ANGEL MORALES.

text.p: Sampdoria said on Tuesday they had signed young attacking midfielder Angel "Matute" Morales from Argentina's Independiente on a five-year contract.
The Genoese serie A club announced the deal in a brief statement. No financial details were given.
The signing had been widely expected, with Independiente coach Cesar Luis Menotti due to take over at Sampdoria and also expected to bring several of his players with him.
Sampdoria have already signed German captain Juergen Klinsmann from Bayern Munich and are expected to sign Napoli's French midfielder Alain Boghossian shortly.
Menotti, the 1978 World Cup-winning coach, replaces departing coach Sven-Goran Eriksson who has moved to Lazio with veteran striker Roberto Mancini and three club officials.
